notes.notes: [p][b]The goal is to build a community, the ability to improve the game.[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Quickly send feedback, on your own behalf or anonymously. [/p][/*][*][p]And also receive in-game bonuses depending on the role in the discord. [/p][/*][/list][p]Subscribers on the patron receive in-game bonuses that do not affect the balance. [/p][p]Other roles in the discord can also give bonuses in the game. [/p][p]Authentication occurs through a web browser in the game, and a remote server is also used. [/p][p][b]The game asks only for your nickname in the discord and your roles on my server in the discord.
